dedupe_keys.name: building age map of vienna around 1920 building stock map 1920

description: This dataset digitises the building stock of Vienna around 1920 from an analog building age map, produced at TU Wien with a co-author from the University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences Vienna (BOKU) and described in Data in Brief. The Zenodo repository contains the building stock map 1920 (BSM_1920 shapefile) with its attribute table, a layer of areas out of scope in 1920, and the scope of the analog building age map; the record states it is required by a related Zenodo dataset (10.5281/zenodo.5832032). Coverage: the city of Vienna, Austria, around 1920. Access: free download of a 14 MB zip from Zenodo (version 1, December 2020). Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a single historical time slice from a digitised map, so linking it to current buildings needs matching with present-day footprints, and parts of the city are out of scope. Simulation uses: assigning construction periods and archetypes to Vienna's pre-1920 stock for energy, material stock and heritage analyses. Related records: the Vienna 3D city model roof models and EUBUCCO.
